verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Q,* and the glorious Quran. 2.
verse_text_arabic: قٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: qaf wal-qur'āni l-majīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: ق والقرءان المجيد

verse_text_english: They found it strange that a warner from among them came to them! The disbelievers said, "This is really strange.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verse_text_transliterated: bal ʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum faqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā shayon ʿajību
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل عجبوا أن جاءهم منذر منهم فقال الكفرون هذا شىء عجيب

verse_text_english: “After we die and turn to dust?
verse_text_arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أءذا متنا وكنا ترابا ذلك رجع بعيد

verse_text_english: We are fully aware of any one of them who gets consumed by the earth; we have an accurate record.
verse_text_arabic: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verse_text_transliterated: qad ʿalim'nā mā tanquṣu l-arḍu min'hum waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قد علمنا ما تنقص الأرض منهم وعندنا كتب حفيظ

verse_text_english: They rejected the truth when it came to them; they are utterly confused.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
verse_text_transliterated: bal kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fahum fī amrin marīji
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل كذبوا بالحق لما جاءهم فهم فى أمر مريج

verse_text_english: Have they not looked at the sky above them, and how we constructed it and adorned it, without a flaw?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
verse_text_transliterated: afalam yanẓurū ilā l-samāi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūji
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفلم ينظروا إلى السماء فوقهم كيف بنينها وزينها وما لها من فروج

verse_text_english: And we created the earth, and scattered on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of beautiful plants.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahīji
verse_text_arabic_clean: والأرض مددنها وألقينا فيها روسى وأنبتنا فيها من كل زوج بهيج

verse_text_english: This is to enlighten and remind every obedient person. 9.
verse_text_arabic: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: tabṣiratan wadhik'rā likulli ʿabdin munībi
verse_text_arabic_clean: تبصرة وذكرى لكل عبد منيب

verse_text_english: And we sent from the sky blessed water, to grow with it gardens and grains to be harvested.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: wanazzalnā mina l-samāi māan mubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātin waḥabba l-ḥaṣīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونزلنا من السماء ماء مبركا فأنبتنا به جنت وحب الحصيد

verse_text_english: And tall palms with clustered fruits. 11.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-nakhla bāsiqātin lahā ṭalʿun naḍīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: والنخل باسقت لها طلع نضيد

verse_text_english: Provisions for the people. And we revive with it dead lands; you are similarly resurrected.
verse_text_arabic: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verse_text_transliterated: riz'qan lil'ʿibādi wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika l-khurūj
verse_text_arabic_clean: رزقا للعباد وأحيينا به بلدة ميتا كذلك الخروج

verse_text_english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, the dwellers of Russ, and Thamûd.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wa-aṣḥābu l-rasi wathamūd
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وأصحب الرس وثمود

verse_text_english: Also, Aad, Pharaoh, and the brethren* of Lot.
verse_text_arabic: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
verse_text_transliterated: waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu wa-ikh'wānu lūṭi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعاد وفرعون وإخون لوط

verse_text_english: And the dwellers of the woods, and the people of Tubba'. All of them disbelieved the messengers and, consequently, My retribution befell them.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-aṣḥābu l-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿin kullun kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأصحب الأيكة وقوم تبع كل كذب الرسل فحق وعيد

verse_text_english: Were we too burdened by the first creation? Is this why they doubt resurrection?
verse_text_arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: afaʿayīnā bil-khalqi l-awali bal hum fī labsin min khalqin jadīdi
verse_text_arabic_clean: أفعيينا بالخلق الأول بل هم فى لبس من خلق جديد

verse_text_english: We created the human, and we know what he whispers to himself. We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد خلقنا الإنسن ونعلم ما توسوس به نفسه ونحن أقرب إليه من حبل الوريد

verse_text_english: Two recording (angels), at right and at left, are constantly recording.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: idh yatalaqqā l-mutalaqiyāni ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli qaʿīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ يتلقى المتلقيان عن اليمين وعن الشمال قعيد

verse_text_english: Not an utterance does he utter without an alert witness.
verse_text_arabic: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما يلفظ من قول إلا لديه رقيب عتيد

verse_text_english: Finally, the inevitable coma of death comes; this is what you tried to evade.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verse_text_transliterated: wajāat sakratu l-mawti bil-ḥaqi dhālika mā kunta min'hu taḥīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجاءت سكرة الموت بالحق ذلك ما كنت منه تحيد

verse_text_english: The horn is blown; this is the promised day.
verse_text_arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: wanufikha fī l-ṣūri dhālika yawmu l-waʿīd
verse_footnote_english: 50:20-29. happenings that took place on the day of judgment. is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونفخ فى الصور ذلك يوم الوعيد

verse_text_english: Every soul came, along with a herder and a witness. 22.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wajāat kullu nafsin maʿahā sāiqun washahīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجاءت كل نفس معها سائق وشهيد

verse_text_english: You used to be oblivious to this. We now remove your veil; today, your vision is (as strong as) steel.
verse_text_arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: laqad kunta fī ghaflatin min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāaka fabaṣaruka l-yawma ḥadīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقد كنت فى غفلة من هذا فكشفنا عنك غطاءك فبصرك اليوم حديد

verse_text_english: The companion said, "Here is my formidable testimony."*
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīdu
verse_footnote_english: *50:23-28 Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقال قرينه هذا ما لدى عتيد

verse_text_english: Throw into hell every stubborn disbeliever.
verse_text_arabic: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīdi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ألقيا فى جهنم كل كفار عنيد

verse_text_english: He was an opponent of righteousness; transgressor, and doubtful. 26.
verse_text_arabic: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin murībi
verse_text_arabic_clean: مناع للخير معتد مريب

verse_text_english: He set up besides GOD another god. Throw him into severe retribution.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhī jaʿala maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fa-alqiyāhu fī l-ʿadhābi l-shadīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذى جعل مع الله إلها ءاخر فألقياه فى العذاب الشديد

verse_text_english: His companion said, "Our Lord, I did not mislead him; he was far astray."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fī ḍalālin baʿīdi
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال قرينه ربنا ما أطغيته ولكن كان فى ضلل بعيد

verse_text_english: He said, "Do not feud in front of Me; I have sufficiently warned you.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال لا تختصموا لدى وقد قدمت إليكم بالوعيد

verse_text_english: “Nothing can be changed now;* I am never unjust towards the people.” 30.
verse_text_arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: mā yubaddalu l-qawlu ladayya wamā anā biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīd
verse_footnote_english: 50:29. soul that is strong, well fed, and well developed (as a result of heeding God’s message), or a soul that is weak, shrunk, and undeveloped (as a result of disregarding God’s message). growth and development completely up to us. See Appendix 10.
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما يبدل القول لدى وما أنا بظلم للعبيد

verse_text_english: That is the day when we ask Hell, "Have you had enough?" It will say, "Give me more."
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali im'talati wataqūlu hal min mazīdi
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم نقول لجهنم هل امتلأت وتقول هل من مزيد

verse_text_english: Paradise will be presented to the righteous, very close.
verse_text_arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna ghayra baʿīdi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأزلفت الجنة للمتقين غير بعيد

verse_text_english: This is what has been promised for every steadfast submitter. 33.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓi
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا ما توعدون لكل أواب حفيظ

verse_text_english: They reverenced the Most Gracious, in their privacy, and came wholeheartedly.
verse_text_arabic: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: man khashiya l-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāa biqalbin munībi
verse_text_arabic_clean: من خشى الرحمن بالغيب وجاء بقلب منيب

verse_text_english: Enter it in peace; this is the day of eternity.
verse_text_arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verse_text_transliterated: ud'khulūhā bisalāmin dhālika yawmu l-khulūd
verse_text_arabic_clean: ادخلوها بسلم ذلك يوم الخلود

verse_text_english: They have deserved whatever they wish therein, and we have even more.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: lahum mā yashāūna fīhā waladaynā mazīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: لهم ما يشاءون فيها ولدينا مزيد

verse_text_english: Many a generation before them, who were more powerful, we annihilated. They searched the land; did they find an escape?
verse_text_arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu min'hum baṭshan fanaqqabū fī l-bilādi hal min maḥīṣi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم أشد منهم بطشا فنقبوا فى البلد هل من محيص

verse_text_english: This should be a lesson for everyone who possesses a mind, or is able to hear and witness.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
verse_text_transliterated: inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā liman kāna lahu qalbun aw alqā l-samʿa wahuwa shahīdu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن فى ذلك لذكرى لمن كان له قلب أو ألقى السمع وهو شهيد

verse_text_english: We have created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue touched us.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin wamā massanā min lughūbi
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد خلقنا السموت والأرض وما بينهما فى ستة أيام وما مسنا من لغوب

verse_text_english: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise, and before sunset.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla l-ghurūb
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاصبر على ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل الغروب

verse_text_english: Glorify Him during the night, and in prostration.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-adbāra l-sujūd
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن اليل فسبحه وأدبر السجود

verse_text_english: Beware of the day when the caller calls from a near place.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-is'tamiʿ yawma yunādi l-munādi min makānin qarībi
verse_text_arabic_clean: واستمع يوم يناد المناد من مكان قريب

verse_text_english: When they hear the truthful blow; this is the day of resurrection.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yasmaʿūna l-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqi dhālika yawmu l-khurūj
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يسمعون الصيحة بالحق ذلك يوم الخروج

verse_text_english: It is we who give life and death, and to us is the ultimate destiny. 44.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verse_text_transliterated: innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wa-ilaynā l-maṣīr
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا نحن نحى ونميت وإلينا المصير

verse_text_english: The day will come when the earth cracks in a hurry, giving rise to them. Such summoning is easy for us to do.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma tashaqqaqu l-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīru
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم تشقق الأرض عنهم سراعا ذلك حشر علينا يسير

verse_text_english: We are fully aware of what they say, while you can never force them. Therefore, remind with the Quran* those who reverence My warning.
verse_text_arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verse_text_transliterated: naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbārin fadhakkir bil-qur'āni man yakhāfu waʿīd
verse_text_arabic_clean: نحن أعلم بما يقولون وما أنت عليهم بجبار فذكر بالقرءان من يخاف وعيد
